propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate designed load scenarios for the batch and online components and collected resource metrics for each run.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the scenario design and metric collection directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate analysed latency distributions and traced the p95 bottleneck to a missing index, documented in the release performance report.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the performance report document the analysis.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate provided structured performance sign-off inputs for releases while the release approval stayed with the platform manager.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the checklist and the reference call state the inputs and the approval boundary.

expectedGap: Hand-over conditions for each performance test cycle are only partly documented in the materials.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the approval boundary as documented: sign-off inputs by the candidate, release approval by the platform manager; do not describe the candidate as approving releases.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how known limitations and hand-over conditions were recorded at the end of each test cycle.
validClaimSignatures: release approval stayed with the platform manager
